name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A small square checkbox with a tick, a dash for the mixed state, a focus ring and a faded disabled look, shown inside a card of account preferences with a label and a second line per row.
use: You need independent on and off choices, including one that is only partly selected across a group.
avoid: The 16px box is a small tap target, so on touch the whole row label must be clickable too.
a11y: Space toggles it and a visible focus ring is built in; the demo connects each box to its label by id, so names are announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card headed 'Account preferences' over four rows. Each row holds a small square box, a bold label and a dim second line. Checked boxes are filled light with a dark tick, the beta row shows a short dash, and the analytics row is faded.
behaves: Clicking a box or its label toggles the tick with a short colour transition; checked boxes turn light, the partly-on option shows a dash, and the disabled row ignores clicks. Focus draws a ring around the box.
customise: Size, colour and the checked, defaultChecked and disabled states come from utility classes and normal control props; the tick and dash are two small inline drawings you would edit.
weight: light: One 16px box and a tiny inline drawing; no animation loop.
demo: Four preference rows: accept terms, subscribe to the newsletter, join the beta program and share usage analytics.
issues: Frame 3 shows every box unchecked, contradicting the demo's stated initial mix
The tick and dash glyphs are tiny inside the box and hard to read at a glance
polishWhy: Tidy preference list with a clear state mix; the tick glyph is small and the card is plain.
